summary: Focused estimator verification completed. No relevant testing skill found. API and UI confirm the main Project Overview flow now recalculates for project_type and foundation_type, the wizard recalculates for foundation_type, and /api/estimator/rate-index returns 200 with fallback material_index=1.0 reflected in calculate multipliers. However the exact contract is still not fully met: utility_scope removal did not change utilities_total/total_project_cost, and multiple editable fields still do not affect total_project_cost.

critical.issue: utility_scope changes do not affect utilities_total for default utility labels. Removing default scopes down to Water/Fire/Electrical returned identical utilities_total 7188596.18 and identical total_project_cost 19994008.26. This violates the requested 'adding/removing utilities changes utilities_total' behavior.

Several editable fields exposed in wizard/Edit Project Overview still do not change total_project_cost: industry_type, continent, bay_spacing_m, soil_type, wind_speed_ms, annual_output_mt, tempering_utility_demand, chocolate_storage_temp_c, process_hot_water_lph, dust_collection_required, cooling_conveyor_load, land_area_sqm, far_fsi, relative_humidity_pct, currency, base_unit.

integration_issues.flow: Edit Project Overview / wizard recalculation completeness
integration_issues.issue: The visible Project Overview flow works for project_type and foundation_type, but backend evidence shows not every editable field influences the calculated cost, so the UI exposes no-effect inputs as cost-driving estimator elements.

action_items: Make utility_scope matching map each UI scope label to the intended UTILITY_SYSTEMS rows so add/remove changes utilities_total.
Either wire every editable field into compute_estimate or stop exposing fields as editable estimator cost drivers if they are informational only.
Retest all no-effect fields listed in backend_issues plus the full Project Overview Save & Recalculate flow.
critical_code_review_comments: compute_estimate defines utilities_share_hint from product_category but never uses it, so changing product_category/industry context has less effect than expected.

utility_scope matching uses substring/first-word heuristics that fail for labels like 'Boiler House' vs 'Steam & Boiler System', 'Chiller Plant' vs 'Refrigeration / Cold Chain', and 'Air Compressors' vs 'Compressed Air System'.
Editable inputs such as bay_spacing_m, wind_speed_ms, land_area_sqm, far_fsi, relative_humidity_pct, several process fields, currency, and base_unit are not used in total_project_cost computation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run /app/tests/bug_estimator_api_verification.py after fixes. UI smoke passed for edit-overview project_type Retrofit lowering KPI, foundation_type Pile raising KPI, wizard foundation recalculation, and sidebar Live Rate Index visibility. API rate-index returned fallback source with material_index=1.0 in this environment, so live external api.gold-api.com source could not be observed here.
rca_of_the_issue: The fix added multipliers for many fields but not every editable field. Utility scope is especially broken because labels from the UI do not match backend UTILITY_SYSTEMS names under the current substring heuristic, and base essentials are always included, so removing default utilities can produce identical utilities_total.
